cases.title: Heat Sink Optimization
cases.rootCause: Thermal resistance and airflow bottleneck must be separated.
cases.solution: Evaluate TIM, contact resistance, fin pitch and fan working point together.
cases.lesson: Increasing heat sink area alone does not guarantee a lower temperature.

cases.title: Fan Selection
cases.problem: Measured airflow is lower than the datasheet free-air flow.
cases.rootCause: The system operating point is limited by pressure drop.
cases.solution: Use the fan P-Q curve with the system impedance curve.
cases.lesson: Always evaluate the actual fan working point.

cases.title: Mesh Independence Study
cases.rootCause: The result is not mesh independent.
cases.solution: Refine hotspot regions and compare engineering outputs across mesh levels.
